title: intake_assessment
description: Is this existing application ours to hold, at which onboarding level, at which criticality tier? Its acceptance sets both in the instance register.

onboarding_level.description: How much of this application maestro may act on. N0 observed, N1 operated, N2 governed; N3 and N4 are not used in the MVP.

criticality_tier.description: What the clocks derive from: severity × tier → respond_by and resolve_by, from the tenant's policy.

reconstructed_purpose.description: Recovered after the fact. Mark its provenance `reconstructed` — never present it as original.
